searchLog: 15th consecutive day of the same network-egress failure (logged 2026-09-22 through 2026-10-04, now 2026-10-05 too). This run re-verified the block before giving up: WebFetch succeeded only on https://www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs (the bare root), and returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for every other domain tried, including job-boards.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, jobs.lever.co, stripe.com, www.databricks.com, www.notion.com, ramp.com, www.startupschool.org, fellowship.mlh.io, and even VC-portfolio mirror boards (jobs.accel.com) that re-host the exact same Anthropic Greenhouse postings under a different domain. WebSearch still works and was used once to check Anthropic's Applied AI Architect postings via search snippets, but per the hunt's verification rule a search snippet is not sufficient to include anything -- the 5 visible Applied AI Architect reqs (Paris/Dublin/London/SF-NYC/NYC, $190k-315k) are senior pre-sales roles, not new-grad, matching target-companies.json's existing note that Anthropic has no new-grad pipeline. The one page WebFetch could load (anthropic.com root) confirmed the same: 55 Applied AI roles (all senior pre-sales), 24 TPM roles (all mid/senior infra-adjacent), and 3 Fellows Program cohorts (AI Safety & Security, ML Systems & RL, The Anthropic Institute) which are research-track and explicitly out of scope per profile.md's 6 target role families. No application page anywhere -- for Anthropic or any of the other ~28 target-companies.json entries -- could actually be fetched and verified, so per the hunt's own rule ('verify by actually fetching the page,' never include on the strength of a search snippet) nothing qualifies. Zero verified opportunities is the correct and honest output for the 15th straight day running. This is not a search-strategy problem -- every company board and every third-party fellowship/accelerator domain tried this run hit the identical EGRESS_BLOCKED response, confirming it is a standing environment network-policy restriction (this session's WebFetch allowlist appears to cover only the anthropic.com root), not a transient outage. It requires a human to widen this scheduled routine's network egress policy to cover standard job-board domains (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable) and company career/program sites -- re-running the hunt won't fix it.
